column1: # What each suite actually returned, measured, not estimated.
# scripts/check-doc-figures.sh compares the figures in six documents against an
# envelope written by hand in that script. That catches a document drifting away
# from the envelope and nothing else: if the envelope is stale in the same
# direction as the document, both agree and the check passes. On 2026-11-01 it
# did exactly that. check-deployment-record.sh had been returning 96 for hours
# while the envelope said 77..91 and three documents quoted 79, 91 and 81. All
# So the envelope is now checked against this file, which holds observations. A
# count that drifts outside its envelope fails, and the fix is to widen the
# envelope deliberately and say why, rather than to discover months later that
# nothing was being compared to reality.
